Account overview: ShieldPoint is a payments-focused contact center operator supporting merchant disputes and high-value payments flows. Heavy compliance: PCI scope across call flows, some PHI in dispute cases, strict retention policies (7+ years for certain records).

Requirements (customer language / notes):
- Must run inside customer VPC or private deployment; no customer data to leave region.
- PHI & PCI: need signed attestation, encryption with KMS/HSM, audit logs for every inference call (who/what/when), retention controls per ticket type.
- SSO/SAML + SCIM provisioning for agents; RBAC controls to isolate audit-only personas.
- Low-latency agent assist: 150-400ms target for token generation at 1–1.5s end-to-end UI latency; spike tolerance up to 10k concurrent agent sessions in peak windows.
- Tool-calling: must support webhooks and secure tokenized tool calls to CRM/OMS; deterministic fallbacks when backend tool is down.
- Ticket summarization + reranking for routing: embeddings batch job + near-real-time rerank on new inbound tickets.
- Cost sensitivity: want Optimize recommendations to reduce per-token cost; open to quantized private models but need quality evals before roll.

POC scope / success criteria:
- Deploy Redwood Private in ShieldPoint VPC with KMS integration; show end-to-end agent assist flow on masked data.
- Show audit log export to ShieldPoint SIEM and sample-query latency < 300ms p95.
- Tool-calling demo to CRM with safe sandbox mode and automatic rollback.
- Verify retention policy enforcement (7y for dispute tickets, 30d for ephemeral notes).
